description_en: Deletes members or task flow developers from a DMS data warehouse development project workspace
description_zh: 调用DeleteLhMembers接口，删除DMS数仓开发项目空间成员或任务流开发者
name: DeleteLhMembers

parameters.help_en:
The object type. Valid values:
0: project workspace
1: task flow
parameters.help_zh:
对象类型，取值如下：
0：项目空间
1：任务流
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en:
The object ID:

The project workspace ID (Id). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424379.html operation to obtain this value.
The task flow ID (Id). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh:
对象ID：

项目空间ID（Id），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424379.html获取该参数的值。
任务流ID（Id），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值

parameters.help_en: The list of target user information
parameters.name: member_ids
